parameters.query:
WITH selected_dispensers AS (
    SELECT p.*, dp.price, d.currency, d.name as distributor_name, d.bin as distributor_bin, d.city as distributor_city, d.address as distributor_address, d.contact_phone as distributor_phone, d.contact_email as distributor_email
    FROM products p
    JOIN distributor_prices dp ON p.sku = dp.product_sku
    JOIN distributors d ON d.id = dp.distributor_id
    WHERE dp.distributor_id = {{ $('Upsert User Session').item.json.distributor_id || 1 }}
      AND p.category = 'dispenser'
      AND p.product_type IN ('hand_towel', 'soap')
      AND p.color = '{{ (() => { try { return JSON.parse($('Call VLM (OpenAI-Compatible)').item.json.choices[0].message.content).recommended_color || 'white'; } catch(e) { return 'white'; } })() }}'
      AND (p.traffic_level = '{{ $('Upsert User Session').item.json.daily_traffic > 200 ? 'high' : ($('Upsert User Session').item.json.daily_traffic >= 50 ? 'medium' : 'low') }}' OR p.traffic_level = 'any')
      AND p.is_focus_item = TRUE
      AND dp.in_stock = TRUE
    LIMIT 2
)
SELECT * FROM selected_dispensers
UNION ALL
SELECT p.*, dp.price, d.currency, d.name as distributor_name, d.bin as distributor_bin, d.city as distributor_city, d.address as distributor_address, d.contact_phone as distributor_phone, d.contact_email as distributor_email
FROM products p
JOIN distributor_prices dp ON p.sku = dp.product_sku
JOIN distributors d ON d.id = dp.distributor_id
WHERE dp.distributor_id = {{ $('Upsert User Session').item.json.distributor_id || 1 }}
  AND p.category = 'refill'
  AND p.system_code IN (SELECT system_code FROM selected_dispensers)
  AND p.is_focus_item = TRUE
  AND dp.in_stock = TRUE;
